stem.en: Between meals, as blood glucose starts to fall, what happens to insulin and glucagon secretion?
stem.et: Söögikordade vahel, kui vere glükoositase hakkab langema, mis juhtub insuliini ja glükagooni eritumisega?

label.en: Glucagon secretion from alpha cells rises, prompting the liver to break down stored glycogen into glucose, while insulin secretion from beta cells falls.
label.et: Alfarakkude glükagooni eritumine tõuseb, ajendades maksa lagundama salvestatud glükogeeni glükoosiks, samas kui beetarakkude insuliini eritumine langeb.

label.en: Insulin secretion continues at the same rate, since its only job (letting glucose into cells) isn't needed when glucose is already low.
label.et: Insuliini eritumine jätkub samas tempos, kuna selle ainus ülesanne (glükoosi rakkudesse laskmine) pole vajalik, kui glükoos on juba madal.

label.en: Glucagon stays in reserve and is not released unless insulin secretion has completely stopped.
label.et: Glükagoon jääb tagavaraks ega vabane, kuni insuliini eritumine pole täielikult peatunud.

label.en: The pancreas shifts from digestive enzyme production to hormone production, since it can only do one job at a time.
label.et: Pankreas lülitub seedeensüümide tootmiselt hormoonide tootmisele, kuna see suudab korraga teha ainult üht tööd.
